name: size
description: Size of the checkbox. Choose based on adjacent text or form components. Default: 'medium'.

name: intent
description: Semantic color intent (primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, neutral). Default: 'primary'.

name: label
description: Label text rendered next to the checkbox. Also required for screen readers to identify its purpose.

name: checked
description: Controlled checked state. Use together with `onCheckedChange` when integrating with form libraries, external state, or when rendering different UI based on the checked state. For simple cases with no state management needed, use `defaultChecked` instead.

name: defaultChecked
description: Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage. Use when you don't need to manage state externally.

name: disabled
description: Whether the checkbox is disabled. Default: false.

name: onCheckedChange
description: Callback fired when the checked state changes. Pair with `checked` for controlled usage.
